_approach: The Dariacore Wiki/Wikipedia note that dariacore features 'hardstyle kicks' and borrows 'the sound design and bass drops of dubstep.' A straight four-on-the-floor kick at full velocity every quarter (the hardstyle-adjacent skeleton, with the pitch-drop body implied rather than modelled), a clap+snare stack on 2 and 4, and a dense closed-hat 16th bed underneath so the groove reads as maximalist even before any sample chop is layered on top.
